Currently allowed origins: exactly `http://localhost:4200`, plus any `*.pages.dev` or `*.workers.dev` subdomain.

**Location:** `worker/src/index.ts`, in the `cors({ origin: (origin) => {...} })` callback (~lines 20-30).

**To add a custom domain:** add a new condition inside that callback, e.g.:
```js
origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com' ||
```
(or `origin.endsWith('.your-custom-domain.com')` for subdomains), returning `origin` when matched. Since Hono's array-based origin matching only supports exact strings (no wildcards), you must use this function form — per `worker/src/index.md` and `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md` §4 (CORS).
